required_invocation: Vendor-supported command or service request captured verbatim
required_input_artifact: Checksum-fixed minimal supported model
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input and every retained artifact
acceptance_criteria: Fresh parseable result bound to input checksum and no error or license failure

required_input_artifact: Recorded nonexistent isolated input path
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable and retained logs
acceptance_criteria: Documented failure and no authoritative output

required_input_artifact: Valid fixture copy with one schema-invalid node
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable malformed input and retained artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic rejection identifies node defect and emits no authoritative result

required_input_artifact: Valid fixture copy with one invalid member reference
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable malformed input and retained artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic rejection identifies member defect and emits no authoritative result

required_input_artifact: Fixture containing one documented unsupported capability
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input and retained artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Explicit unsupported failure or governed partial result with no silent omission

required_input_artifact: Schema-valid empty structural model if parser permits
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input and retained artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Fail-closed result and no stale or successful output

required_input_artifact: Valid current input with seeded prior-run outputs
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input seed and outputs
acceptance_criteria: Prior output is rejected or replaced atomically and result binds current input

required_input_artifact: Valid input and conflicting output names
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input seed and outputs
acceptance_criteria: Overwrite behavior is deterministic and cannot publish mixed-run artifacts

required_invocation: Vendor-supported invocation under controlled supervisor timeout
required_input_artifact: Supported long-running fixture
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input logs and partial files
acceptance_criteria: No authoritative result and documented cleanup after timeout

required_input_artifact: Supported long-running fixture
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input logs and partial files
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation is distinguishable from success and leaves no publishable output

required_input_artifact: Valid minimal model
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input and retained logs
acceptance_criteria: License failure is explicit and cannot be ingested as success

required_input_artifact: Two checksum-distinct valid fixtures
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable inputs logs and outputs
acceptance_criteria: No cross-run file collision data mixing or ambiguous status

identity_target: Repository ingestion plus selected external identity

required_input_artifact: Controlled corrupt copy of a genuine checksum-fixed output

required_invocation: Same invocation under two vendor-supported locales
required_input_artifact: Same checksum-fixed minimal model
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input and outputs for each locale
acceptance_criteria: Representation is documented and semantics agree or unsupported locale fails explicitly

required_invocation: Three isolated serial runs with identical settings
required_input_artifact: One checksum-fixed representative valid fixture
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input and every output
acceptance_criteria: Three runs meet predeclared exact-field and numeric tolerance after approved normalization

required_invocation: Vendor-supported invocation for each signed component
required_input_artifact: Checksum-fixed component-isolating unit-load fixtures
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable fixtures outputs and worksheet
acceptance_criteria: Each component basis and sign is unique and equilibrium closes within predeclared tolerance

checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable both inputs outputs and worksheet
acceptance_criteria: Observed permutation and sign mapping matches a predefined mechanically checked transformation

required_input_artifact: Asymmetric fixture with a non-global support basis if supported
checksum_requirement: SHA-256 of executable input output and worksheet
acceptance_criteria: Constraint and reaction are mapped by a verified orthonormal transformation or feature is explicitly unsupported

required_input_artifact: Valid minimal fixture

acceptance_criteria: Expired state is distinguishable from valid completion and publishes no result
